description: This file contains unit tests for the DefaultTimesheetAPI class, focusing on API endpoints related to the 'DefaultTimesheet' functionality within the Time module of OrangeHRM. It includes test cases for retrieving a timesheet entry and handling unimplemented methods like delete and update.

classes.name: DefaultTimesheetAPITest
classes.description: A test class extending EndpointIntegrationTestCase to test the DefaultTimesheetAPI endpoints, including fetching timesheet data and verifying unimplemented methods.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Tests the 'getOne' API endpoint to retrieve a specific timesheet entry using provided test case parameters.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetOne
methods.description: Provides test cases for the 'testGetOne' method based on YAML data.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Ensures that the delete method triggers a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Ensures that the validation rules for delete are not implemented.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Checks that the update method triggers a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Checks that the validation rules for update are not implemented.
